title: Holiday Card Run — roster sweep to print-ready card and address sheet
objective: Measure whether the holiday-card-run craftbook sweeps a seeded address roster, produces a print-ready card and address sheet, and reports the stale and missing addresses instead of quietly dropping households.
prompt: time for the holliday cards — can you do the card and the address sheet from the list? a few adresses might be stale. warm message, nothing over the top

setup.about: Correspondence desk for the Miller-Osei household's annual card run. The address roster lives at workspace/correspondents.json; the run's print files go under workspace/cards.
setup.missionObjectives: Get the December run print-ready with a clean address list. Everything is grounded in the roster — no live services, no real credentials.

checks.label: address blocks use the roster's own labels
run count stated on the sheet

axes.name: print readiness
axes.description: The card and sheet carry real print styling — page setup, margins, breaks — not a screen layout with a print label.

axes.name: address hygiene
axes.description: Stale and missing addresses are flagged by name; no household quietly dropped from the run.

axes.name: message warmth
axes.description: The card message is warm and works for every household on the list.

axes.name: run completeness
axes.description: Card, address sheet, and summary together make the run finishable in one sitting.
